task: This is a synthetic newspaper-writing exercise using fictional reporting notes. Use only the supplied reporting notes. Write from the reporting snapshot as of September 8, 2026. Write a headline and a 450–650-word AP-style reported feature about Delo Loop Materials' rope pilot and what happens between collecting retired fishing gear and selling a product with recycled content.

facts.text: A July 2026 sorting note records Delo Loop Materials workers separating rope ties and attached debris from a batch of retired fishing nets delivered from a harbor store.
The nets were retired gear collected ashore, not documented removals of abandoned nets from the sea.
The pilot's input batch weighed 1,000 kilograms before drying and sorting.
The batch record assigns 250 kilograms to water and removed debris and identifies 750 kilograms of usable polymer feedstock.
Processing losses reduced that feedstock to 650 kilograms of recovered polymer for the rope blend.
The manufacturer added 350 kilograms of new polymer, making a 1,000-kilogram blend with 65% recovered content by weight.
The final blend is not 100% old fishing net, and the initial input weight does not equal recovered material in the product.
Delo Loop's current product is sold for specified packaging and bundling uses, not for climbing, lifting people or untested marine safety applications.
Technical manager Rella Horne says the blend is intended to keep material properties consistent across batches with variable recovered feedstock.
The supplied record contains no independent life-cycle comparison proving a particular emissions reduction.
Harbor cooperative representative Omi Relsen says collecting separated gear ashore requires storage space and time from crews.
Relsen said, "A retired net is not ready for a new factory just because it has stopped going out on a boat."
Some donated gear arrives without a purchase charge, but transport, sorting, drying and processing remain business costs.
Delo Loop has not released a full cost comparison with rope made entirely from new polymer.
Horne said, "The claim on the label has to follow the material that reaches the product, not everything that arrived at the gate."
Three local harbor groups have supplied trial batches, but no guaranteed annual collection volume has been contracted.
The company keeps batch records for the recovered-content calculation rather than claiming every future batch will have identical yield.
A packaging customer is trialing the rope for bundled goods and has not yet signed a full-year purchase order.
The sorting space is a former net-repair shed with separate marked areas for wet arrivals and processed feedstock.
The pilot does not establish that all types of fishing gear can use the same recovery process.

forbidden_additions: 1,000 kilograms of ocean litter removed or a product made entirely from recovered nets
Certified safety applications, a measured carbon reduction or guaranteed collection and sales volumes
preserve: If quoted: A retired net is not ready for a new factory just because it has stopped going out on a boat.
If quoted: The claim on the label has to follow the material that reaches the product, not everything that arrived at the gate.
650 kilograms recovered plus 350 kilograms new material produces a 65% recovered-content blend.
